merges.name: Adentro
merges.reason: one company: the live list renders it 'Adentro' at /portfolio/zenreach/ (Ajay Agarwal, 2015); the 2018-2022 archive rows carry its Zenreach name (Wikipedia: Zenreach, 'Prior to emerging from stealth, Adentro had raised $20 million ... Bain Capital Ventures')

merges.name: Zero Hash
merges.reason: one company: Seed CX rebranded to Zero Hash in September 2020 ('Chicago cryptocurrency startup raises $5M, rebrands to Zero Hash', Business Journals); the 2022 archive renders 'Zero Hash' at /portfolio/seed-cx (2018-2021 rows carry the Seed CX name; Salil Deshpande)

merges.name: Sansoro Health
merges.reason: one position: Sansoro Health merged with Datica in June 2019 and the firm's own 2020-2022 page /portfolio/sansoro-health carries the name Datica; the investment is Sansoro (a share swap at the merger reads as sale consideration, COLLECTION.md s1), so the Datica row folds into it

merges.name: DaVinci Payments
merges.reason: one lineage: Swift Prepaid Solutions (bought in 2019 by Syncapay, which BCV backs) renamed daVinci Payments, whose 2020-2021 page on the firm's site stays /portfolio/swift-prepaid-solutions; daVinci merged with North Lane in December 2020 and rebranded Onbe (the 2022 archive row)

merges.name: Venminder (Digital Comply)
merges.reason: one company: Venminder's registered name is Digital Comply; the firm's 2013 page /portfolio/company/digital-compliance is its earlier rendering (Michael Krupka)

merges.name: Driven
merges.reason: one company: Concurrent, Inc. (San Francisco, the company behind Cascading; BCV's 2014 Form D, Salil Deshpande) rebranded as Driven, which the firm listed in 2016-2017; Xplenty acquired it in 2017

merges.name: Futuredontics
merges.reason: one company: Futuredontics runs the 1-800-DENTIST referral service; the live list carries Futuredontics (marked acquired), the 2011-2013 archive rows carry the 1-800-Dentist brand (Paul Zurlo, Weston Gaddy)

merges.name: Basis
merges.reason: one project: the algorithmic stablecoin launched as Basecoin (the firm's 2018 page) and renamed Basis the same year; both archive rows carry Salil Deshpande

merges.name: MediaRadar
merges.reason: one company: MediaRadar (New York ad-sales intelligence) began as MagazineRadar; the firm's archive rows carry both names

merges.name: TargetSpot
merges.reason: one position: BCV led TargetSpot's $8.6M Series B in 2008 (USV's post, 2008-03-11); Radionomy bought TargetSpot (2012-2014), and the live list's 'Radionomy (Azerion)' with invest year 2008 is that position under the acquirer's name (a share swap at a sale reads as sale consideration, COLLECTION.md s1), so the Radionomy row folds into TargetSpot

merges.name: Symphony Commerce
merges.reason: one company: sneakpeeq (the social shopping site of 2011-2012) and Symphony Commerce file under one SEC issuer CIK, 1517646, with Ajay Agarwal on both; the firm listed sneakpeeq in 2011-2013 and Symphony Commerce from 2016
